title: Time, Place and Symbol
welcome_lead: Time of day, season and symbolic place all carry atmosphere.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on time, season and symbolic setting.
final_note: You can now layer time and symbol into atmosphere reading.

walkthroughs.body_html: Dawn often = hope; dusk = ending; winter = death; spring = renewal. Writers use these conventions to cue mood quickly.
An overgrown garden can symbolise neglect; a tower, isolation. Symbolic settings carry theme as well as place.
Switching from a warm kitchen to a freezing street uses contrast in atmosphere to deepen feeling and meaning.
